content: Money formatting in RN (Hermes): Hermes IntlAPIs doc (facebook/hermes, fetched 2026-08-06): Intl.NumberFormat IS supported on both platforms but delegates to platform ICU/CLDR — output (incl. currency symbol rendering) VARIES by Android OS version (CLDR 28-36.1 depending on API level) and iOS version; formatToParts is ANDROID-ONLY (unsupported on iOS). So Intl.NumberFormat('en-PH',{style:'currency',currency:'PHP'}) is non-deterministic across devices and formatToParts-based formatting breaks on iOS. Verdict for this project: keep manual formatting in money.js (cents -> '1,234.50' -> 'P 1,234.50' style) — deterministic everywhere — matching ADR-0003. Input parsing pitfalls: strip currency symbol, commas, and spaces before parse; PHP uses '.' decimal and ',' thousands; treat user input as integer cents via (parseFloat(clean)*100) is a float pitfall — better regex: match digits and single decimal point, split on '.', Math.round to cents. Avoid toFixed() rounding on float paths.
